vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, high-density enterprise SaaS

form_builder.structure: 3-column layout. Left sidebar (280px) for Field Palette. Center area for Canvas. Right sidebar (320px) for Field Configuration.
form_builder.panels: border-r border-l border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm z-10

layout_and_spacing.density: High density. Use tightly packed components for Master Data Tables and Configuration forms. Use p-4 for panel sections, p-2 for individual configuration rows.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Sharp corners or minimal rounded-md (4px) to emphasize functional technicality.

general.card: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift, border darkens.
general.buttons: High contrast. Primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50.
general.inputs: Shadcn default inputs but force text-sm, 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 border-blue-500.
general.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for Formula Builder and PDF Builder. Must have backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40 overlay.

form_builder_specific.field_palette: Draggable items must have a clear grab handle icon. Use generic card look: border border-slate-200 p-3 flex items-center gap-3 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50.
form_builder_specific.configuration_panel: Use Shadcn Tabs for [General, Data Source, Lookup, Formula, Validation, Advanced]. Inside tabs, use Shadcn Accordion for dense grouping.
form_builder_specific.formula_builder: A Code Editor-like UI. Dark mode or high contrast light mode. Must use different colors for Field Tags (Green), Functions (Blue), and Numbers (Purple).
form_builder_specific.master_data_table: Dense data tables with sticky headers. Horizontal and vertical scrolling. Use Shadcn Table + Pagination.

icons_and_media.usage: Use Phosphor icons in 'regular' or 'bold' weight. Avoid 'duotone' for this technical dashboard.

empty_state_network.description: Abstract data network for empty states in Master Data or Form Workflow areas.

user_avatar.description: Professional headshot for Admin/Vendor profile avatar.

company_logo.description: Monochrome abstract company logo for the top-left dashboard nav.

motion_and_interactions.drag_drop: Use smooth transitions for sorting items. Highlight drop zones with a dashed blue border and light blue background (bg-blue-50 border-blue-400 border-dashed).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use fast, snappy transitions for tooltips and accordions. duration-150 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have a visible hover state. Ensure text color contrast is maintained on hover.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute. Example: data-testid='field-palette-text-input', data-testid='config-tab-validation', data-testid='formula-builder-save-btn'.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_management: Ensure focus states have higher contrast. Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500.
accessibility_and_testing.aria_labels: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like delete field, copy field).

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (use .jsx or .js, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use Zustand or standard React Context for the complex Form Builder state to avoid excessive prop drilling between Canvas, Sidebar Config, and Field Palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.drag_and_drop: Implement drag and drop functionality natively with HTML5 or use a lightweight library like @dnd-kit/core (preferred for React) or react-beautiful-dnd.
instructions_to_main_agent.formula_engine: The formula builder needs a reliable parser. Build a standard evaluation function or use a library like mathjs. The UI must clearly map 'Field IDs' (e.g., {{site_capacity}}) distinct from standard strings.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_structures: Maintain a strict schema for form fields: { id, type, label, lookupConfig: { sourceTable, sourceColumn, targetColumn }, formulaConfig: { expression, dependencies }, validation: { required, min, max } }.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_usage: Do NOT use HTML <select>. Always use Shadcn DropdownMenu or Select. Use Shadcn Table for Master Data management.
